translate.welcome:
🌍 *AI Translator*

Translate text between any languages.

_Send me text to translate in this format:_

```
Translate to [language]:
[your text here]
```

_Or just send text and I'll ask you the target language._

Examples:
• `Translate to Spanish: Hello, how are you?`
• `Translate to Japanese: I love programming`
• `Translate to French: What time is it?`
